description: AGSC-07-29: the three C4 levels as Mermaid text (https://c4model.com/): level 1 draws the architecture as the node `system` and, as external nodes, the listed items outside the selection that a member reaches, one edge for each distinct key; level 2 draws the Concepts of the selection in a subgraph named by the architecture's title with the authored Links and the port wiring between them; level 3 draws the other members, `settle-run` here, inside the subgraph of the code-point-least Concept that an authored Link joins it to. Fixture: the saved architecture `order-platform` selects `orders` and `settle-run`; `orders` requires `inventory` (added by closure), uses the listed `email`, is decided by `adr-queue` (as `inventory` is) and produces the port `order-placed`, which `settle-run` consumes; `settle-run` is verified by the listed `settle-check`. The blueprint is written by `compose --from order-platform --brief` and only then, into the `blueprint/` subdirectory of the companion directory, never into the Harness directory (AGSC-07-29); two builds write the same bytes.
